name: hh-arc-settler
notes: Settlement worker for Hopping Heads Arc. Holds OPERATOR_KEY; asks hh-arc-signer for signatures over loopback. Register from its own clone of the repo. Env (OPERATOR_KEY, CHAIN_ID, ARC_RPC_URL, ESCROW_ADDRESS, DATABASE_URL, SIGNER_URL, SIGNER_TOKEN, POLL_MS, RECEIPT_DEADLINE_MS, MAX_ATTEMPTS, SETTLE_VIA_MEMO) lives in Pier; see .env.example. Deploy checks out the reviewed commit named in deploySteps, never pulls. Log lines starting with ALERT are the ones to page on.
